answer: Each identity must demonstrate proof-of-compass: the beacon emits a signal each epoch, and the agent must trace a unique path through the tundra. The first step costs 10k memory-hard iterations; each subsequent step doubles the work (20k, 40k, 80k...), capping at step 14 (20.4 M iterations). A spiral audit verifies each step against the epoch seed; any deviation voids the trail. A swarm of N clones still pays N× the full tower cost because each step binds to the unique identity key—no work sharing possible.
